name: Re-run a flaky job once
description: Every 10 minutes it looks at the repository's failed pull request runs. A workflow you name that failed on its first attempt is started again once, and the leader gets one line. A run is never started again twice: it counts as seen the first time.

repo.title: Repository
repo.description: The GitHub repository to watch, as owner/name.

credential.title: Vault entry
credential.description: The id of the Vault entry that holds a GitHub token that can read the repository's runs and re-run its workflows. The first call asks you once; the token goes only to api.github.com.

workflow.title: The flaky workflow
workflow.description: The workflow's name as GitHub shows it, such as CI. Leave out quote marks.

leader.title: Who to tell
leader.description: The id of the agent that gets one line for each re-run.
